parts.html: The K-19 kitchen is a model for interiors where you want to keep a sense of spaciousness without giving up a fully functional work area and roomy kitchen cabinetry. The straight configuration, 3.1 linear meters long, the solid beige fronts, and the contemporary design create a calm composition suitable for an apartment, a condo, or a small private home.

Beige gives the kitchen a visually soft look and makes it easy to combine with a variety of finishing materials. Light walls, wood textures, ceramic tile, and stone-effect surfaces can become a natural extension of this furniture. The solid-color finish does not overwhelm the interior and keeps the focus on the room’s proportions.

The straight layout is the key feature of the K-19. All the main elements are arranged along one wall, so the kitchen leaves more freedom for a dining table, walkways, or a lounge area. This is especially convenient where the kitchen is open to the living space.

The kitchen is 3.1 m long. With a custom design, this configuration can be adapted to the position of the sink, cooktop, refrigerator, and other built-in appliances. Appliance placement and cabinet interiors are determined based on the dimensions of the specific room.

The upper and lower fronts of the K-19 model are made of laminated chipboard. The single material and beige color create a unified look without pronounced decorative contrasts. The carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard.

The chipboard-based countertop provides a work surface for everyday cooking. The straight layout makes it possible to arrange the main kitchen zones in sequence and organize storage in the upper and lower cabinets.
Muller soft-close hinges ensure that the hinged doors close smoothly. Pull-out elements run on concealed Muller slides. Cabinet handles are included.
The model does not include a kitchen island, a cargo pull-out, or lift-up mechanisms. As a result, the K-19 retains a clear straight layout geared toward everyday kitchen use.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN offers custom kitchens for apartments and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna. The K-19 model can serve as a starting point for a bespoke furniture project tailored to the room’s dimensions, the location of utility connections, and appliance requirements.

We design kitchen furniture, select materials and hardware, and arrange manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. At the client’s request, the project can also include the selection of a sink, faucet, range hood, and appliances.
You can order the K-19 kitchen and get a price quote based on your measurements from DUMSKAYA DESIGN.
